preview.text: India won the toss and chose to bowl first against West Indies in the one-day match at Barsapara Cricket Stadium. In their 59 recorded one-day meetings, India has won 40 and West Indies has won 18. The forecast for the next 8 hours indicates up to a 100 per cent chance of rain and about 30 degrees.

summary.text: India won the match by 8 wickets after chasing down a target of 405-7 set by WI innings. Amir Jangoo was the top scorer for WI with 114 off 77 balls, while Kuldeep Yadav took 2 for 65. In reply, India scored 406-2 with Shubman Gill (c) top scoring with 223 off 133 balls, and Shamar Joseph claimed 1 for 52.
